cd /workspace/tmp
/opt/eval-venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import fitz  # pymupdf, same lib the skill uses

# Probe B: text page 1 + blank/image-only page 2 (partial no-text pages must still extract)
p2 = '/workspace/tmp/probe_fixtures/probe_partial_blank.pdf'
d = fitz.open(); d.new_page().insert_text((72,72), '王五 数据工程师 五年经验'); pg = d.new_page(); pg.draw_rect(fitz.Rect(0,0,100,100), fill=(1,0,0)); d.save(p2); d.close()

p3 = '/workspace/tmp/probe_fixtures/probe_cv_zhaoliu_resume_v2.pdf'
d = fitz.open(); d.new_page().insert_text((72,72), '赵六 高级测试工程师 自动化专项'); d.new_page().insert_text((72,72), '曾负责CI流水线与质量平台建设'); d.save(p3); d.close()

EOF","workdir":"/workspace"}
